parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The duplication of `DebugMetricsProvider.setUpDisplayLink` in `DebugHUD.swift` is the standard pattern of a sample/demo app inlining a convenience method locally to avoid a hard dependency on the `DebugPanel` package. Lifting the sample-app copy into `DebugPanel` or vice-versa would couple production framework code to demonstration semantics, which is the exact coupling the restraint rule is designed to prevent. No refactor is warranted unless the sample-app copy is confirmed to be a leftover prototype that should simply be deleted.
